initial_parent_scope.shared_purchase_policy: Existing fk_purchase_process/fk_purchase_confirmations delivery, pickup and collection records remain authoritative. Generic fulfilment must not duplicate them until a separately reviewed bridge exists.

deferred_records.name: handoff_or_return_record
deferred_records.reason: Defer until Outcome/Evidence semantics can distinguish participant assertion from attested or external evidence.

lifecycle.correction_rule: After a milestone leaves planned state, correction/retry is a new milestone whose supersedes_milestone_id references the earlier milestone in the same plan.
lifecycle.completion_rule: completed_at is server-set participant coordination assertion and never independently proves a real-world Outcome.

authorization.read: inherit readable parent Economic Flow / parent Cooperation membership
authorization.responsible_user_rule: must already be a parent Cooperation member
authorization.rpc_pattern: SECURITY DEFINER, search_path empty, actor server-derived, explicit validation, PUBLIC/anon execute revoked

location_policy: No new address/GPS/location target field in v0. Reuse parent Cooperation coarse location context; first-class Place linkage waits for the Place contract.
truth_boundary: Fulfilment stage/milestone completion is coordination state. It is not payment settlement, legal transfer, independent delivery proof, quality verification or confirmed Outcome.

mura_delta.rule: Authored Mura milestones remain illustrative and cannot be presented as real delivery/payment/contract/evidence.

acceptance_journey.summary: A Project-owned non-regulated production/distribution flow uses explicit fulfilment milestones, preserves one failed step and its superseding correction, and ends with participant-marked completion while Outcome/Evidence remains separate.

migration_gate.rule: No database migration is authorised by this design contract.
